Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients at high-risk for an acute myocardial infarction, including any 2 of these risk factors: males age > 45; females age >55; family history of premature coronary heart disease (CHD); current cigarette smoker; hypertension; or elevated total cholesterol with low HDL and/or high LDL.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is male >45, has family history of premature CHD (paternal father died at 62), and elevated LDL (190 mg/dL) with no mention of HDL/LDL specifics, meeting two criteria.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: OR have: - Active angina (chest pain due to coronary heart disease) - History of coronary heart disease according to the treating physician - Past history of myocardial infarction documented by electrocardiogram or arteriography - Diabetes Mellitus - Renal dialysis
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has documented history of recurrent myocardial infarctions and diabetes mellitus type 2, fulfilling two OR criteria.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Last hospitalization was during bypass surgery at age 55 (6 months prior), not within 4 weeks.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Persons living in a home with previously enrolled patients
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's living situation or home status is not specified in the data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients disoriented to person, place, or time at onset of study
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No cognitive impairment or disorientation is mentioned in the patient's profile.

Recap: Patient meets inclusion criteria for high-risk MI (male >45, family history of premature CHD, elevated LDL) and has documented history of myocardial infarctions and diabetes. No recent hospitalization or cognitive issues noted.
